_comment: Original BF16/FP16 safetensors -> abliteration (refusal-direction orthogonalization, Arditi et al.) -> target=auto verified quantizer. Abliteration edits high-precision weights shard-by-shard on CPU (torch), then the result is quantized; the source directory is never touched. Supply the refusal direction via jailbreak_params.direction_file (a .npy/.pt vector of length hidden_size, e.g. exported from heretic); omit it and install transformers to collect it from harmful/harmless calibration instead. NVFP4/GGUF inputs are refused. Behavioral change is not verified by the edit; measure refusal before/after with the quality report.
